newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3919/3.3936 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3919/3.3936 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3915 to 3.3935 pounds bid and 3.3930 to 3.3935 offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3919 pounds bid and 3.3936 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3923 pounds bid and 3.3937 pounds offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388504 buy and 3.397390 sell.
